description:
A safety engineer is planning a confined space entry into a sump pit and needs to assess vapor accumulation risks. Use CAMEO Chemicals (https://cameochemicals.noaa.gov/) to look up the 'Vapor Density' (relative to air) for these 5 chemicals: Hydrogen Sulfide, Ammonia, Chlorine, Carbon Monoxide, and Sulfur Dioxide.

Create a safety report at '~/Documents/confined_space_vapor_report.txt' following this format:

CONFINED SPACE VAPOR DENSITY ASSESSMENT
========================================

Chemical: [Name]
Vapor Density: [Value from CAMEO]
Classification: [HEAVIER/LIGHTER/SIMILAR]

(Repeat for all 5 chemicals)

SUMMARY
========================================
Chemicals that accumulate in LOW areas: [list]
Chemicals that accumulate in HIGH areas: [list]
Chemicals that disperse evenly: [list]

RECOMMENDATION
========================================
[Safety advice based on findings]

Classification Rules:
- HEAVIER: Vapor Density > 1.1
- LIGHTER: Vapor Density < 0.9
- SIMILAR: Vapor Density between 0.9 and 1.1
